name: qa-docs
description: Domain documentation for QA: researches the code of many repositories, Jira and Confluence, and writes a verified domain document as short linked pages (overview, one page per process, reference pages) with diagrams rendered to PNG, then builds Confluence pages from it (Confluence HTML with a local preview) and exports them as a page tree with the diagrams uploaded as pictures; also brings old Confluence pages up to date in their own structure. Never changes code.

confluence_pages.title: Confluence pages
confluence_pages.description: After a document is approved (or with /qa-docs:report), build confluence/: the pages as they will be published, with a local preview. Publishing is still /qa-docs:export.

visual_page.title: Visual page (Artifact)
visual_page.description: After a document is approved (or with /qa-docs:report), build an interactive overview of the domain (processes with diagrams, rules, differences from Jira/Confluence, what to test, open questions) and publish it as a private Artifact on claude.ai.
